verdict.rationale: The pack documents no Postman-native capability for setting up automations that run autonomously in the background. There are no scheduled or recurring runs and no background agent tasks. What it does show is adjacent: the Postman CLI running collections inside an external CI/CD pipeline (where the host CI does the scheduling), always-on mock servers (simulation, not automation), and Agent Mode, which acts interactively on natural-language prompts. The generic "build automation into your workflow" line does not describe an autonomous background feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
